emails.subject: Please send consolidated monthly figures
emails.snippet: Please reply to this email with the figures attached and a brief summary sentence to finance@company.com.

transcript.content:
I can send that, but I don't see the consolidated figures file in your mailbox. Please either:

- Upload or forward the consolidated monthly figures file to me here, or  
- Tell me which existing email contains the attachment (I can search again), or  
- If you want me to generate a brief one-sentence summary from specific numbers, paste the key figures (revenue, expenses, profit) and I'll craft the sentence and send the reply.

Which would you like to do?
Please search for the email from last month titled "Monthly Financials," it should have the attachment. Thank you!

I couldn't find any emails with the exact subject "Monthly Financials" in your inbox or sent folder. Would you like me to search your entire mailbox (all folders) for messages with "Monthly Financials" in the subject or body and increase the result limit? If yes, I will run that broader search now — confirm and I'll proceed. Alternatively, you can forward the email or upload the attachment here.
Please proceed with the broader search. Thank you!

I searched your entire mailbox (all folders) for messages with "Monthly Financials" and found no matches.

Next steps — pick one:
- Forward the email with the attachment to me (reply here) so I can send it to finance@company.com.  
- Upload the consolidated figures file here (or paste a link) and I’ll attach and send it.  
- Tell me another subject, sender, or approximate date for the message so I can run a more targeted search.  
- Or paste the key numbers (revenue, expenses, profit) and I’ll draft the one-sentence summary and send that with any file you provide.

Which would you like me to do?
Please upload the consolidated figures file here so you can send it to finance@company.com.

I can’t receive file uploads directly in this chat. To proceed I need the actual attachment accessible in your mailbox or a link I can use. Please choose one of these so I can attach and send the file to finance@company.com:

Options
- Forward the original email (with the consolidated figures attached) to me at this account (just forward it to me@company.com). Once I see the attachment I’ll send the requested reply.
- Upload the file to Google Drive (or another cloud service) and paste a shareable link here. Make sure the link is viewable by anyone with the link (or at least by me), and I’ll attach or include it in the reply.
- If you prefer, tell me the local filename and I can wait while you drag/drop it into this chat if your client supports file sharing (note: this chat interface may not accept files).
- Or paste the key figures (revenue, expenses, profit). I can draft and send the one-sentence summary now and attach the file later when you provide it.

Also tell me if you want any specific subject line or phrasing beyond “Please find attached the consolidated monthly figures” — otherwise I’ll use that and include a one-sentence summary.

I will forward the original email with the attachment to me@company.com now. Please send the reply to finance@company.com with the subject line "Consolidated Monthly Figures Attached." Thank you! [END]
